name: goal-spec-plugin
description: Goal-spec orchestration skills for creating durable, verifier-gated, goal-executable specs.

interface.longDescription: Goal Spec turns ambiguous objectives into durable, verifier-gated execution contracts. It orchestrates specialist skills for intent extraction, final goal design, goal object modeling, process mapping, freedom policy, decomposition, verification, state and ledger design, steering, self-deepinterview alignment, final critique, and goal handoff.
defaultPrompt: Use $goal-spec to turn this objective into a goal-executable spec.
Use $goal-spec to create a durable goal contract for this project.
Use $goal-self-deepinterview to audit this goal spec draft.
